svg.title: Proposed tray_assignment class structure
svg.desc: Strategy pattern: Scheduler holds a tray_assignment::Solver; DefaultSolver and a test fake realize it; Solve takes a read-only Input and returns stdx::Expected<Result>; Scheduler applies the Result.
